findings.span: Join 2 million happy users of LumoraPay!
findings.source_text: Lumora Pay has 2 million registered users. (expired 2026-09-30; owner: Comms team)
findings.why: This repeats fact F01, which expired on 2026-09-30.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove this claim, or ask Comms team for the current figure before using it.

findings.source_text: Approved: 'Lumora Pay'. Always two words, both capitalised.
findings.why: 'LumoraPay' is a banned variant. Use 'Lumora Pay'.

findings.span: We are India's fastest payment app
findings.why: Factual claims must be supported by an approved source in the brand kit.
findings.suggested_fix: LumoraPay is a secure payment app

findings.source_text: Substantiate product claims. Make factual claims only when supported by a current approved source in the brand kit. Avoid: Every transfer arrives instantly.
findings.why: Product claims must be substantiated by a current approved source, and transfers do not always arrive instantly.

findings.source_text: Make instructions accessible. Do not rely on color, position, or an image alone to communicate an instruction or status. Avoid: Tap the green button above.
findings.why: Instructions must not rely on color, position, or an image alone.

findings.span: sign up now or miss your chance
findings.source_text: Sound confident, not pushy. Explain what Lumora can do without pressuring people or promising an outcome. Avoid: Sign up now or miss your chance to get rich.
findings.why: Sound confident, not pushy, and avoid pressuring people or using phrases like sign up now or miss your chance.

findings.source_text: State fees accurately. Describe fees only with current approved details, and make any conditions easy to notice. Avoid: All transfers are always free.
findings.why: The brand guidelines state to avoid claiming that all transfers are always free and require accurate fee descriptions.
findings.suggested_fix: Review our current fee structure for details on transfer costs.

findings.span: you are guaranteed to save money every month
findings.source_text: Avoid guarantees. Never guarantee earnings, savings, approval, or uninterrupted service. Avoid: You are guaranteed to save money every month.
findings.why: The brand guidelines explicitly forbid guaranteeing earnings, savings, approval, or uninterrupted service.
findings.suggested_fix: Lumora Pay helps you manage your money effectively.

findings.span: Lumora Pay supports transfers in 12 currencies, so you can pay anyone, anywhere.
findings.source_text: Lumora Pay supports transfers in 12 currencies. (expired 2026-08-31; owner: Product marketing)
findings.why: This repeats fact F02, which expired on 2026-08-31.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove this claim, or ask Product marketing for the current figure before using it.

findings.span: We would like to take this opportunity to inform you that our new infrastructure migration is now live.
findings.source_text: Be clear and concise. Put the main point first. Keep sentences short and remove words that do not help the reader. Avoid: We would like to take this opportunity to inform you that your transfer has now been initiated.
findings.why: The text is wordy and does not put the main point first.
findings.suggested_fix: Our new infrastructure migration is now live.

findings.source_text: Keep feature names consistent. Use the approved name for each feature. Do not invent abbreviations or alternate labels. Avoid: Check your spend dashboard (SID) for monthly spend.
findings.why: It uses an unapproved abbreviation or alternate label for the feature.

findings.source_text: Be transparent about next steps. Tell customers what will happen next and what action, if any, they need to take. Avoid: You're all set.
findings.why: It lacks transparency about next steps and what action the customer needs to take.
findings.suggested_fix: Please check your account for further updates.
